name: DaxLib.SVG.Element.Defs
description: Create a <defs> element from one or more `DaxLib.SVG.Def.*` elements

parameters.name: defs
parameters.description: Concatenated list of def elements to include in a <defs> block

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Element.Defs' =
		(
			defs: STRING    // concatenated list of elements to include in a <defs> block
		) =>

			"<defs>" &
			defs &  
			"</defs>"
